sentences.text: MAN: Hello, Steynford College external course registration, can I help you?
sentences.zh: MAN: 你好，这里是斯泰恩福德学院校外课程注册处，有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yeah, I'm ringing to find out about one-day classes next year. I got a leaflet about them in the post but I lost it, and I understand some of the classes are filling up fast, so I might need to book quite soon if I want to go ahead.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，我打电话来想了解一下明年的一日课程。我之前收到过一份关于这些课程的宣传单，但弄丢了；而且我听说有些课程名额正迅速报满，所以如果我想报名的话，可能得尽快预订。

sentences.text: MAN: Sure. Can you remember which one you were considering?
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。您还记得自己考虑的是哪一门课吗？

sentences.text: WOMAN: There were a few actually. I remember there was one on how to make Vietnamese food that sounded good. I think that was on the 13th of January.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 实际上有好几门。我记得有一门是教如何制作越南菜的，听起来不错，好像是在1月13日。

sentences.text: MAN: It cost about 60 pounds.
sentences.zh: MAN: 费用大约是60英镑。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yes, you're right about the date, but it's 59 pounds actually. It's a very popular class, and among other things the teacher explains how Vietnamese food includes lots of different herbs. I'm afraid that all the places are taken at present, but I can put you on the waiting list if you want?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您说的日期没错，但实际费用是59英镑。这门课非常热门，老师还会讲解越南菜中大量使用各种香草的特点。很抱歉，目前所有名额均已报满，不过如果您愿意，我可以把您加入候补名单。

sentences.text: MAN: No, that's OK. I'm quite interested in the bread making class. That's in March sometime, isn't it?
sentences.zh: MAN: 不用了，谢谢。我对面包制作课挺感兴趣的，那门课应该是在三月某个时候，对吧？

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yeah, the 20th of March. Would you like to register for that?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对，是3月20日。您要登记报名这门课吗？

sentences.text: MAN: I'm not sure. How much is it?
sentences.zh: MAN: 我还不确定。费用是多少？

sentences.text: WOMAN: The actual cost is £48 but then there's an extra charge as well as that for the ingredients - I'm not sure how much that is, no more than twenty pounds I think.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 课程本身费用是48英镑，此外还需额外支付食材费——具体金额我不太确定，但应该不会超过20英镑。

sentences.text: MAN: So what sorts of things do they make in the class?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那么课堂上主要制作哪些种类的面包呢？

sentences.text: WOMAN: Oh, various types of bread; I think they make white bread and then they make sourdough, that seems to be very fashionable at present, and they learn how to make pizza, which is apparently really good.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，各种类型的面包；比如白面包，还有酸面团面包——目前这种面包特别流行，另外他们还会学习制作披萨，据说味道真的很好。

sentences.text: MAN: Well I'd definitely be interested in that, but there were also a few other classes that sounded interesting. I think there was one on face massage? I'd love to learn how to do that.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，这门课我肯定感兴趣，不过还有几门其他课程听起来也很有意思。我记得好像有一门面部按摩课？我很想学这个。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yeah, that's on the 23rd of February and it costs just £35 for the day. The teacher's great, the type of massage done is a traditional technique used in India and she actually did her training there. The massage is meant to relax you and get rid of lines and wrinkles. You practise it on yourself so you have to take a mirror to the class, so you can see what you're doing.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对，这门课安排在2月23日，全天费用仅为35英镑。授课老师非常优秀，所教授的按摩手法是一种源自印度的传统技术，她本人就在印度接受过专业培训。这种按摩旨在帮助放松身心，并减轻细纹和皱纹。学员需自行练习，因此上课时需要自带一面镜子，以便观察自己的操作。

sentences.text: WOMAN: OK.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.text: MAN: And I think there was a class in candle making?
sentences.zh: MAN: 还有一门蜡烛制作课，我也记得有。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yes that's sometime in April, I think. Let me check... yes, it's on the 6th. It was on the 23rd of January but they had to change the date. It's just £52. That's a popular course too. I think one reason why people like it is because the candles are all made out of natural products. It's filling up fast but there's still a few places left.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，这门课安排在四月的某个时间，让我查一下……对，是4月6日。原定于1月23日举行，但后来更改了日期。费用仅为52英镑。这也是一个热门课程，人们喜欢它的原因之一在于所有蜡烛均采用天然原料制成。目前报名进展很快，但尚余少量名额。

sentences.text: MAN: Yes one of my friends did that class. She said the candles make really good presents. In fact she gave me one.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，我有个朋友参加过这门课。她说这些蜡烛特别适合作为礼物，事实上她还送了我一支。

sentences.text: WOMAN: By the way, have you heard about the class on silk painting? That's being held on the 18th of May. You learn how to create designs on silk fabric and colour them using special dyes. Apparently people can produce beautiful artworks that way, either to put on the wall as a picture or to use for something like a scarf.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对了，您听说过丝巾绘画课吗？这门课将于5月18日举办。您将学习如何在真丝面料上创作图案，并使用特制染料为其上色。据称，人们能借此创作出精美的艺术作品，既可作为装饰画挂在墙上，也可制成围巾等实用物品。

sentences.text: MAN: It's £67.50, which is really good value I think - there's a similar class I've seen that was £110.
sentences.zh: MAN: 费用是67.50英镑，我觉得性价比非常高——我见过类似课程收费高达110英镑。

sentences.text: WOMAN: That sounds interesting. Would I need to bring the silk?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 听起来很有趣。我需要自带丝绸吗？

sentences.text: MAN: No, the only thing is everyone has to bring something to protect their clothing, like an apron if you've got one, or a shirt that you don't use any more, because the dye can really stain your clothes.
sentences.zh: MAN: 不用，唯一的要求是每位学员都得带件能保护衣服的东西，比如围裙（如果你有的话），或者一件你不再穿的旧衬衫，因为染料很容易弄脏衣服。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Right. Then the last class I was considering was a bit different, that was on DIY for beginners. I'd like to learn how to do household repairs. Are there any places left on that?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。然后我考虑的最后一门课有点不同，是面向初学者的DIY课程。我想学些家居维修技能。这门课还有空位吗？

sentences.text: MAN: That's on the 24th of February - yes, there are a few places. It's a bit more expensive - it's £125 - but it's a very popular class. You learn how to use an electric drill and a saw.
sentences.zh: MAN: 这门课在2月24日开课——对，还有几个空位。费用稍高一些，为125英镑，但非常热门。你会学习如何使用电钻和锯子。

sentences.text: WOMAN: Yeah, that would be really useful, and I even need to learn how to use a hammer because I always end up hitting my fingers.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是啊，这确实非常实用；而且我甚至还得学怎么用锤子，因为我总是一不小心就砸到自己的手指。

sentences.text: Yes, you'll do that too. And when you've learned how to use the basic tools, you do a practical job which is fixing a shelf to a wall.
sentences.zh: 是的，这门课也会教。等你掌握了基本工具的使用方法后，还要完成一项实操任务：把一个搁板固定到墙上。

sentences.text: Great. Just what I need to know. Right, well I'd like to enrol for that and also for
sentences.zh: 太好了，这正是我需要掌握的内容。好的，那我想报名这门课，另外也想报……

sentences.text: Here is some information about history and nature walks in the region. They can be completed in less than a day and also be combined with a visit to Melby, a former coal mine now open to the public.
sentences.zh: 这里有一些关于该地区历史与自然徒步路线的信息。这些路线均可在一天之内完成，也可与参观梅尔比（Melby）——一座现已向公众开放的前煤矿——相结合。

sentences.text: The Marsden Coastal Walk is suitable for all the family as there are no strenuous climbs.
sentences.zh: 马斯登滨海步道适合全家老少，沿途没有陡峭的攀爬路段。

sentences.text: The route begins at Marsden harbour, where there are hourly ferries to and from the beautiful Hooker Island, a great place for fishing. The walk covers part of the coastal path trail. As there are clear signposts all along the way, you don't even need to take a map with YQJJ• At one point, the route goes inland slightly and passes a castle built in the 1400s near to a now-vanished market town. The castle's now just a pile of stones but it's a great place to take photos, and fascinating information boards show what it once looked like. If you set off early, you can be back in time for midday.
sentences.zh: 这条路线始于马斯登港，那里每小时都有渡轮往返风景优美的胡克岛（Hooker Island），该岛是垂钓的理想场所。此步道覆盖了部分滨海小径。由于沿途设有清晰的指示牌，您甚至无需携带地图。途中有一段路线会略微向内陆延伸，经过一座建于15世纪的城堡，该城堡毗邻一座现已消失的市镇。如今城堡仅余一堆石块，但却是绝佳的拍照地点；而富有启发性的信息展板则展示了它昔日的样貌。若您早些出发，便能赶在中午前返回。

sentences.text: The Melby Heritage Walk is a great place to take photos, especially of the night sky. At certain times of the year, people come here from far and wide. They climb to the top of the valley and take pictures of the stars. In the daytime, it's completely different. As you hike through the dense woods in the valley bottom, the only things you'll hear are the sound of your own footsteps. At the highest point, you can stop to take in the views, and those with lots of energy can climb the tower that's situated where there was once a seventeenth century hunting lodge. The route continues along the tops of the hills and brings you back down to the starting point - the car park at Melby Coal Mine.
sentences.zh: 梅尔比遗产步道是拍摄照片的绝佳地点，尤其是夜空照片。每年特定时节，人们从四面八方赶来，登上山谷顶端，拍摄璀璨星空。白天时景象则截然不同：当您穿行于山谷底部茂密的林间小径时，耳边唯有自己脚步的回响。抵达最高点后，您可驻足欣赏全景；体力充沛者还可登上一座塔楼——此处原为一座17世纪的狩猎小屋。随后路线沿山脊顶部延伸，最终带您回到起点——梅尔比煤矿停车场。

sentences.text: Melby Coal Mine has been open to the public for twenty years and has won awards for its visitor experience. Many of the buildings around the mine are still standing and have been converted into display areas.
sentences.zh: 梅尔比煤矿已向公众开放二十年，并因其卓越的游客体验屡获殊荣。矿区周边许多建筑至今仍屹立不倒，并已被改造为展览区域。

sentences.text: 011/12 011/12 013/14 013/14 Firstly, there's an exhibition showing the history of the mine, with many original black and white photos. To see that, you go from the car park, via a covered walkway to the Main Visitor Centre. Go through the ticket office to an area where there are lockers to leave heavy bags in. and where you can borrow raincoats. Beyond that room is the exhibition.
sentences.zh: 首先，这里设有一场展示煤矿历史的展览，展出大量原始黑白照片。参观该展览需从停车场出发，经由一条有顶棚的通道前往主游客中心；穿过售票处后，即到达一个设有储物柜（供寄存大件行李）及可供借用雨衣的区域；再往前便是展览厅。

sentences.text: There's a small bathhouse where miners used to wash after their shift underground. You can see that in the building directly to the north of the engine house. The boiler has gone from there now, but there are lines of tin baths on the stone floor.
sentences.zh: 这里有一座小型浴室，矿工们过去在地下作业结束后便在此清洗身体。该浴室位于动力机房正北方向的建筑内。如今锅炉已拆除，但石质地面上仍整齐排列着一排锡制浴盆。

sentences.text: There's a display of early mining tools from the days before mechanisation. You can find that in a small L-shaped building in the middle of the northern boundary of the site. It's incredible to think how miners were able to use hand implements to cut through rock.
sentences.zh: 这里陈列着机械化采矿时代之前使用的早期采矿工具。该展品位于场地北边界中央的一座小型L形建筑内。令人难以置信的是，矿工们当年仅凭手工工具便能凿穿坚硬岩层。

sentences.text: The vehicle shed, where you can find wagons of different sizes, along with some of the hi-tech cutting machines that were in use until the mine closed, is in the southwest corner of the site. and can be accessed via a covered walkway.
sentences.zh: 车辆棚位于场地西南角，内有各种尺寸的矿车以及一些直至煤矿关闭前仍在使用的高科技切割设备。该棚可通过一条有顶棚的通道进入。

sentences.text: There is a field with ponies. which are always popular with children. on the north-eastern boundary of the site, not approached via a covered walkway.
sentences.zh: 在场地东北边界处有一片牧场，里面饲养着小矮马，深受儿童喜爱；该区域不设顶棚通道通往。

sentences.text: The other building to mention is the education centre. This is where school groups go when they visit the mine, but it's also accessible to the public as it contains a library and small gift shop. The centre is connected to the ticket office via a short section of covered walkway.
sentences.zh: 另一处值得一提的建筑是教育中心。学校团体来访时通常在此开展活动，但公众亦可进入参观，因中心内设有一座图书馆及一家小型礼品店。该中心通过一段短距离的有顶棚通道与售票处相连。

sentences.text: TUTOR: Thanks for coming along, Nadia and Fergus. So this is a chance for you to give us some feedback about different aspects of your course. What would you like to begin with?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 感谢你们的到来，纳迪亚和弗格斯。今天这次会议是你们就课程不同方面提供反馈的好机会。你们想先从哪方面开始？

sentences.text: NADIA: I've enjoyed the sessions on food safety. There was some information there that I found really surprising, although some was stuff I knew already, like the rise in rates of obesity.
sentences.zh: NADIA: 我很喜欢关于食品安全的课程。其中有些信息让我感到非常意外，不过也有一些内容是我原本就了解的，比如肥胖率上升的问题。

sentences.text: FERGUS: Yeah, that's been in the news a lot. But I hadn't realised that unsafe food causes more than 200 different diseases.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 是啊，这在新闻中报道得很多。但我之前并不知道不安全食品会导致200多种不同的疾病。

sentences.text: NADIA: No. I'd no idea it was that many. And speaking of diseases, I knew resistance to antibiotics is on the increase, but I didn't know why...
sentences.zh: NADIA: 不知道。我完全没想到会有这么多。说到疾病，我知道抗生素耐药性正在加剧，但一直不清楚原因……

sentences.text: FERGUS: ... that it's partly because when animals are treated with antibiotics then consumed by humans. the antibiotics get into the food chain. I had no idea about that either.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: ……原因之一是动物在接受抗生素治疗后被人食用，抗生素便由此进入食物链。这一点我之前也完全不知道。

sentences.text: NADIA: Then the sessions provided a lot of information about plastic pollution from food packaging in the ocean, but I think that most of us were already aware of that.
sentences.zh: NADIA: 接着，课程还提供了大量关于食品包装塑料污染海洋的信息，但我觉得我们大多数人对此早已有所了解。

sentences.text: FERGUS: Yeah. But I thought we could have done more on how much food is thrown away unnecessarily through fear of it being out of date, that was only mentioned in passing.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 是的。不过我认为，我们本可以更深入地探讨一下因担心食品过期而被不必要丢弃的现象——课程中仅一笔带过而已。

sentences.text: TUTOR: OK, I'll bear that in mind. What did you think about the sessions from visiting lecturers, Fergus?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的，我会把这点记下来。弗格斯，你对客座讲师的授课内容有什么看法？

sentences.text: FERGUS: For me the most interesting one was about that project to prevent companies giving incorrect information to consumers about food.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 对我而言，最有趣的一场讲座是关于一项旨在防止企业向消费者提供错误食品信息的项目。

sentences.text: TUTOR: Ah, food fraud, yes.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 啊，就是食品欺诈问题，没错。

sentences.text: FERGUS: I thought it was really good to address a problem that's faced by so many different groups - people with special religious rules. as well as vegetarians and vegans.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 我觉得能直面这样一个影响众多不同群体的问题，非常有意义——例如遵守特定宗教饮食规则的人群，以及素食者和纯素食者。

sentences.text: NADIA: And those with allergies.
sentences.zh: NADIA: 还有对某些食物过敏的人群。

sentences.text: FERGUS: Yeah. And another thing, we've had effective ways of analysing DNA for some time now and these can easily be applied to analysing food. But what the researchers succeeded in doing was to ensure that these tests were carried out at different stages in the food's journey from the producer to the consumer.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 没错。另外，我们已拥有有效的DNA分析技术多年，这些技术很容易应用于食品分析。但研究人员成功之处在于，确保这些检测在食品从生产者到消费者整个流通过程的不同阶段均得以实施。

sentences.text: NADIA: So they knew that the food actually came from the place it was supposed to, and had the ingredients it was meant to.
sentences.zh: NADIA: 因此他们能够确认食品确实来自其标示的产地，并含有其所宣称的成分。

sentences.text: FERGUS: Exactly. So customers can be confident about what they buy.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 没错。这样消费者就能对自己所购食品充满信心。

sentences.text: NADIA: And the researchers had a good system for publicising their findings too.
sentences.zh: NADIA: 而且研究人员还建立了一套良好的体系来公开发布他们的研究成果。

sentences.text: FERGUS: Well, I thought there were some problems with that, actually.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 嗯，实际上我觉得这方面存在一些问题。

sentences.text: TUTOR: OK. And do you have any recommendations for new topics that we could include in the course?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的。那么，你们有没有什么建议，比如课程中可新增哪些主题？

sentences.text: NADIA: Well, I'm interested in how crop yields can be increased without damaging the environment.
sentences.zh: NADIA: 我对如何在不破坏环境的前提下提高农作物产量很感兴趣。

sentences.text: FERGUS: But we've already done quite a bit on that - but not so much on the seafood industry. where stocks are in danger of being overexploited as a food source unless we can find ways of keeping stocks up.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 但我们在这方面已经讲得相当多了——而对海产品产业的关注却相对不足。若不能找到方法维持鱼类资源，作为食物来源的海产储量正面临过度捕捞的危险。

sentences.text: NADIA: Yes. that'd be a good topic. And I'm interested in the idea of a personalised approach to diet, now we have the technology to analyse exactly what individuals need.
sentences.zh: NADIA: 是的，那会是个不错的主题。而且我现在对个性化饮食理念很感兴趣，因为我们现在已有技术可以精确分析每个人的具体需求。

sentences.text: FERGUS: That sounds more like a medical topic than food science.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 这听起来更像是医学话题，而非食品科学。

sentences.text: NADIA: OK. What about sessions on the variety of food and eating habits around the world? That's very relevant nowadays.
sentences.zh: NADIA: 好吧，那关于全球各地食物种类与饮食习惯的专题讲座如何？这在当今非常相关。

sentences.text: FERGUS: Yes. I think the whole class would be interested in that.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 是的，我觉得全班同学都会对此感兴趣。

sentences.text: NADIA: Then there's technological stuff. things like 3D printing of food and smart packaging.
sentences.zh: NADIA: 然后还有技术类内容，比如食物3D打印和智能包装。

sentences.text: FERGUS: Mmm - maybe too specialist.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 嗯——可能过于专业了。

sentences.text: TUTOR: Now, I'm particularly interested in your project - the one where you developed a new food product. So talk me through the stages... first you had to decide on your initial aim.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 现在，我对你们的项目特别感兴趣——就是你们开发了一款新型食品的那个项目。所以请向我介绍一下各阶段……首先，你们需要确定最初的目标。

sentences.text: FERGUS: We decided we wanted to create something people could eat on the go rather than in a restaurant.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 我们决定要创造一种适合边走边吃的食物，而不是只能在餐厅里享用的食物。

sentences.text: NADIA: Yeah so we chose falafel, which was originally a Middle Eastern snack.
sentences.zh: NADIA: 对，所以我们选了鹰嘴豆饼（falafel），它原本是一种中东小吃。

sentences.text: FERGUS: 023/24 025/26 025/26 We made up our minds about that pretty quickly. I know some students found it a lot harder to choose, and wasted a lot of time.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 023/24 025/26 025/26 我们很快便就此达成一致。我知道有些同学在选择时困难得多，还浪费了很多时间。

sentences.text: NADIA: Then we had to do the literature review. We hadn't done one of these before so. the handout with advice for the project was very useful here.
sentences.zh: NADIA: 接着我们要做文献综述。我们之前从未做过这类工作，因此项目指南中提供的建议在此处非常有用。

sentences.text: FERGUS: Yes. especially the advice on how to present the information. Then product development, actually deciding what we'd use to make the falafel, and for me the interesting thing about that was that we wanted it to be something a bit different from an ordinary falafel.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 是的，尤其是关于如何呈现信息的建议。然后是产品开发阶段，即实际确定制作鹰嘴豆饼所用的原料；而对我来说，这一阶段有趣之处在于：我们希望成品与普通鹰嘴豆饼略有不同。

sentences.text: NADIA: We really made the right choice when we finally decided to use jackfruit, even though it wasn't something that either of us had ever tasted before.
sentences.zh: NADIA: 当我们最终决定采用菠萝蜜时，确实做出了正确的选择，尽管在此之前我们俩都从未尝过这种食材。

sentences.text: FERGUS: Yeah, like the name tells you, it's a fruit but actually it's really good in savoury dishes. The product production, working out how to make the falafel, was harder than I expected because I'd never made them before.
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 没错，正如其名所示，它是一种水果，但实际上非常适合用于咸味菜肴。产品制作阶段——即研究如何制作鹰嘴豆饼——比我预想的更难，因为我此前从未做过这种食物。

sentences.text: NADIA: It was mostly trial and error. We started off with the basic recipe and then experimented and when it went wrong...
sentences.zh: NADIA: 这基本上靠反复试验。我们先从基础食谱入手，再不断尝试；一旦失败……

sentences.text: FERGUS: ... which it did a lot of the time...
sentences.zh: FERGUS: ……而这种情况经常发生……

sentences.text: NADIA: ... we just moved on and kept adapting it and in the end it turned out fine and we had a lot of fun.
sentences.zh: NADIA: ……我们就直接继续推进，不断调整改良，最终结果还不错，而且整个过程也充满乐趣。

sentences.text: FERGUS: We did!
sentences.zh: FERGUS: 确实如此！

sentences.text: TUTOR: Thank you. Well, your project was a very good....
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 谢谢。嗯，你们的项目完成得非常出色……

sentences.text: For my presentation today I'm going to talk about some of the issues facing the cruise ship industry and then some ways these can be addressed. The cruise ship industry has partly been responsible for the effects of overtourism in recent decades. Overtourism occurs in places where excessive numbers of tourists cause significant problems. Pollution, for example, is among the greatest threats to many popular tourist destinations.
sentences.zh: 今天我的演讲将探讨邮轮产业面临的一些问题，以及解决这些问题的一些方法。近几十年来，邮轮产业在一定程度上导致了过度旅游现象的发生。过度旅游是指游客数量过多、从而引发严重问题的地区。例如，污染是许多热门旅游目的地面临的最大威胁之一。

sentences.text: Of course, for many places it's a difficult balance to achieve. They want to promote their city or island as a desirable tourist destination, but at the same time, are unable to cope with thousands of cruise ship passengers on a daily basis. The trouble is, excessive tourism is destroying the beauty spots and places of interest that people come to visit. Several cities, such as Barcelona, have responded by imposing a tax which all visitors to the city from cruise ships have to pay. But as it's only a couple of euros, many green campaigners think it won't deter enough people to make any difference.
sentences.zh: 当然，对许多地方而言，这是一道难以把握的平衡题：它们希望将自身城市或岛屿打造为理想的旅游目的地，但同时又无法应对每天成千上万邮轮乘客带来的压力。问题在于，过度旅游正在破坏人们慕名而来的风景名胜与人文景点。包括巴塞罗那在内的多个城市已采取措施，向所有乘邮轮抵达该市的游客征收一笔税费。但由于这笔费用仅几欧元，许多环保人士认为它不足以阻止足够多的游客，因而无法产生实质影响。

sentences.text: Bruges is another city which became impossible to navigate at times because of the huge numbers of cruise passengers arriving on day trips from the port of Zeebrugge. The city was becoming like a 'theme park', with shops only catering for tourists, selling chocolate, which Belgium is famous for, and other souvenirs. The local council took action to limit cruise passengers to a more manageable level.
sentences.zh: 布鲁日是另一座因大量邮轮乘客从泽布吕赫港一日游涌入而一度变得难以通行的城市。该城正逐渐变成一座‘主题公园’——商店只面向游客，售卖比利时著名的巧克力及其他纪念品。当地市政委员会已采取行动，将邮轮乘客数量限制在更易管理的水平。

sentences.text: Dubrovnik had to limit the numbers of cruise ships after it became extremely popular as a cruise ship destination when it featured in a hugely successful TV series. What it does now is control the timing of all cruise ship entries to the city's port. However, many people feel this measure does not go far enough.
sentences.zh: 杜布罗夫尼克在一部大获成功的电视剧中出镜后，迅速成为热门邮轮目的地，不得不开始限制停靠邮轮的数量。目前，该市通过管控所有邮轮进入其港口的时间来加以管理。然而，许多人认为这一措施仍远远不够。

sentences.text: Cruise ships may be unpopular in some of their destinations but they also have an image problem. They've always been perceived as a safe holiday for the elderly, with not much on offer for families or young couples. A recent survey showed that cost is also a major factor in putting younger groups off going on a cruise. But what they don't realise is that compared to other types of package holidays, cruises can actually be good value, as all activities and drinks are often included. And another perception is that cruises have lots of rules about what to wear and how to behave. But these days, most cruises are no longer very formal and behind the times.
sentences.zh: 邮轮在部分目的地虽不受欢迎，自身也存在形象问题。长期以来，邮轮被视作专为老年人提供的安全假期，对家庭或年轻情侣却缺乏吸引力。最近一项调查显示，价格高昂也是令年轻群体却步的主要因素之一。但他们并未意识到，与其他类型的打包度假产品相比，邮轮其实性价比很高，因为船上活动及饮品通常均已包含在内。另一种普遍看法是，邮轮对穿着和行为规范有诸多限制。但如今，大多数邮轮已不再拘泥于繁文缛节，也不再陈旧过时。

sentences.text: So what solutions are there for cruise lines to overcome some of these problems? How can they appeal to younger customers? Well one selling point is that cruise ships are becoming more sustainable. New ships are built with hybrid engines with large batteries which means ships do not have to keep their engines running while docked.
sentences.zh: 那么，邮轮公司有哪些解决方案可应对上述部分问题？又该如何吸引年轻客户呢？其中一个卖点在于，邮轮正变得越来越可持续。新型邮轮配备混合动力引擎及大型电池，这意味着船舶靠港时无需持续运转发动机。

sentences.text: Cruise lines are also designing ships specially for those in the age range of 21 to 45. The decor in these feels contemporary and there are a range of activities on board that you wouldn't find on a more traditional cruise. There's even a boxing ring on one ship, and most offer diving expeditions. But there's also a huge focus on well-being with a variety of sessions of different kinds.
sentences.zh: 邮轮公司还专门针对21至45岁年龄段旅客设计新船。这类邮轮内部装潢现代感十足，船上活动种类丰富，远超传统邮轮所能提供。其中一艘邮轮甚至配备了拳击台，多数邮轮还提供潜水探险项目。此外，健康养生也成为重点，提供多种类型、形式各异的养生课程。

sentences.text: Food is always a very important part of any cruise and cruise ships have had to radically update their menus to suit the tastes of their younger customers. Vegan dishes are standard, for example. The restaurants on board have also gone paperless with menus available on screen.
sentences.zh: 美食始终是任何一次邮轮之旅的重要组成部分，而邮轮公司也必须彻底更新菜单，以迎合年轻顾客的口味。例如，纯素食菜品已成为标配。船上餐厅亦全面实现无纸化，菜单均以屏幕形式呈现。

sentences.text: Unlike older generations who went on cruises largely to get away from everything, younger people expect to be able to keep in touch with friends and family. Many people going on longer cruises also spend time working, so companies have to guarantee wifi that can be relied upon at all times.
sentences.zh: 与老一辈人主要为远离一切而选择邮轮不同，年轻人期望能随时与亲友保持联系。许多参加长期邮轮旅行的人还会利用时间工作，因此邮轮公司必须确保全程提供稳定可靠的Wi-Fi服务。

sentences.text: My grandparents used to love looking through cruise brochures, even when they weren't planning on going on a cruise. Until very recently TV ads for cruises always felt dated and aimed at retirees. Cruise lines have been slow to adopt the power of social media but that's all changing. Leading cruise lines now employ top agencies to produce first rate videos for social media channels.
sentences.zh: 我祖父母过去常爱翻阅邮轮宣传册，即便当时并无出游计划。直到不久前，邮轮电视广告仍显得过时，目标受众明显是退休人群。邮轮公司采纳社交媒体力量的步伐一直较为迟缓，但如今这一状况正在改变。主流邮轮公司目前已聘请顶尖广告公司，为其社交媒体平台制作一流水准的视频。

sentences.text: It will be interesting to see whether...
sentences.zh: 未来是否会……
